canzone.definition:
n. A song or air for one or more voices, of Provencal origin,
   resembling, though not strictly, the madrigal.
n. An instrumental piece in the madrigal style.

canzones.translation: 合组歌( canzone的名词复数 )

canzonet.definition: n. A short song, in one or more parts.
canzonet.translation: n. 小坎佐尼, 小曲

canzonets.definition:
plural of canzonet
n. A short song, in one or more parts.
canzonets.translation: (canzonet 的复数) n. 小坎佐尼, 小曲
